query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN briefData IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_brief,
  SUM(CASE WHEN urgencyScore IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_urgency_score,
  MAX(briefGeneratedAt) as last_brief_generated
FROM companies
WHERE searchId = 750001;
